# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]
* [ Patients' Stories ][17]
  
  Patients’ journeys inspire our work and drive our commitment.

  We’re engaging with industry thought leaders to explore how science and innovation advance

  We are a community of diverse professionals working together to drive better healthcare options.
* [ Community Engagement ][20]
  
  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]

  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.

  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]


[Patient pictured kneeling next to her Golden Retriever]
[Patient Story][53]

### From Pump to Pup: Finding Comfort in 'Baxter'

Izzy, a young cancer fighter and survivor, loves her dog, Baxter, named after the brand she saw on
the infusion pumps that delivered her chemotherapy.

[Read More][54]
[nurse smiling and standing next to a window ]
[Healthcare Insights][55]

### Technology and Service Support Chronic Disease Management at Home

Conditions such as hypertension, respiratory illnesses and cardiac issues can be monitored
effectively with innovative tools and connected devices.

[Read More][56]
[group event at a baseball game]
[People of Baxter][57]

### The Power of Teamwork to Support Patient Care

Teams bridged the pandemic and borders to bring an innovative ICU bed to life.

[Read More][58]
[Collage of images showing innovations in a manufacturing setting]
[Healthcare Insights][59]

### Supply Chain Innovation Delivers More Nimble, Efficient Solutions

Leaders from Baxter speak about our evolutions in manufacturing and supply chain processes as we
emerge from the COVID-19 pandemic

[Read More][60]
[Kim sitting at her desk smiling]
[People of Baxter][61]

### A Teacher at Heart

After losing her parents to heart disease, Kim resolved to share her knowledge about cardiac
monitoring with HCPs to identify potential issues early.

[Read More][62]
[Chabot graphic]
[Healthcare Insights][63]

### Dr. Chatbot Will See You Now

What role will AI play in healthcare in the future? We believe there are realistic opportunities for
AI to make healthcare more efficient and effective

[Read More][64]
[ Press Release ][65]

### Baxter Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report Highlighting Refreshed Strategy, Ongoing Commitment
### to Drive Meaningful Impact

[Read More][66]
[ Press Release ][67]

### Baxter Reports First-Quarter 2026 Results

[Read More][68]
[ Press Release ][69]

### Baxter Showcases Recent Innovations at AORN Global Surgical Conference and Expo 2026

[Read More][70]

## Our Commitment to Healthcare Professionals and Patients

We are committed to supporting patients and healthcare professionals with innovations that are
driven by compassion for their journeys, a passion to improve care and the ambition to transform the
future of healthcare.

[A doctor in a hospital room looks off to the side]

## Products for Healthcare Professionals

### Primary Care [ Primary Care Go to Primary Care ][71]

Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
vitals monitoring and vision screening

[ Go to Primary Care ][72]

### Hospital Care [ Hospital Care Go to Hospital Care ][73]

Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
workflows

[ Go to Hospital Care ][74]

### Surgical Care [ Surgical Care Go to Surgical Care ][75]

Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
outcomes

[ Go to Surgical Care ][76]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][77]

Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and at
home

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][78]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][79]

Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve mobility

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][80]

### Our Products [ Our Products Go to Our Products ][81]

Enabling clinicians to treat patients more efficiently and effectively across care settings,
including in the office-based practice, inpatient care, outpatient care and at home

[ Go to Our Products ][82]
[Two ladies have a discussion in a coffee shop]

## For Patients

You are our passion. Your stories inspire us to work harder at bringing innovations that can make
your experience easier, speed recovery and enable the best possible quality of life.

[Discover Patient Stories][83]

### More For Patients

### General Healthcare [ General Healthcare Go to General Healthcare ][84]

Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
support every step of your journey.

[ Go to General Healthcare ][85]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][86]

When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide clinical nutrition
options to help you regain your nutritional status.

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][87]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][88]

We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven respiratory
therapy in the hospital and at home.

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][89]

## Bringing our Purpose to Life

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to
be an agent of change at a global level. This means doing what is right for our planet, our patients
and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

### Our Leadership

Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet our commitments – every
day and everywhere.

[Learn More About Our Leadership][90]

### Our Corporate Responsibility

For nearly a century, we have made a meaningful difference in global healthcare while creating
lasting value for the communities we serve.

[Learn More About Our Corporate Responsibility][91]

### Careers

This is where an inclusive community of diverse individuals is driven to go beyond what is, to what
is possible in healthcare.

[Learn More About Careers at Baxter][92]

### Our History

For more than 90 years, we’ve been focused on our commitment to save and sustain lives with
innovations that elevate patient care, improve outcomes and drive healthcare transformation.

[Learn More About Our History][93]

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

# We are Committed to Life

[More][106]
[

### Vision

We strive to transform Fresenius Kabi in the decade to come. We are committed to increase
efficiencies in the therapy and care of patients and improve access to high-quality healthcare
around the globe.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][107]
[

### Excellence

We are specialized in lifesaving medicines and technologies for critically and chronically ill
patients. With our passion and expertise, we touch the lives of almost 450 million people every
year, each one representing the importance of our work.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][108]
[

### Sustainability

We constantly strive to improve our sustainability footprint. For us, meeting the needs of patients
and healthcare professionals goes hand in hand with responsible and ethical management.

[nurse taking hand of woman]
][109]
[

### Think Beyond: Latest Evidence for Effective Therapies in CKD

Join experts at the Global Renal Nutrition Webinar on June 16, 2026. Explore ERA 2026 insights,
protein‑reduced diets, and targeted CKD nutrition.
[Global Kidney Nutrition Webinar Key Visual]
][110]
[

### Women Who Shaped Us

At Fresenius Kabi, colleagues worldwide share personal stories for International Women’s Day,
honoring the women who shaped their courage and purpose.
[Images of Fresenius Kabi employees being interviewed on international womens day.]
][111]
[

### Fresenius Kabi recognized as a Top Employer in 13 countries

Fresenius Kabi has been certified by Top Employers Institute as a Top Employer for 2026 in 13
countries and additionally two regions.
[Image showing the top employer 2026 seals of the 13 countries and 2 regions.]
][112]
[

### Four Colleagues, Four Scientific Journeys: Voices of Women in Science

Female scientists from Biopharma, MedTech, Nutrition and Pharma share their stories and advice,
showing how science careers impact patient care and innovation.
[Image of women in science.]
][113]
[

### Meet The Heroes Behind Patient Safety

Unseen heroes ensure patient safety through precision, care, and smart tech at Fresenius Kabi.
Discover how people make the difference.

and gadgets.]

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

Question and Answer

[ FAQ ][89]

What is Albendazole?

Albendazole is an anti-parasitic active ingredient widely used as veterinary medicine to treat pets
and livestock against internal parasites. Veterinary doctors prefer to treat internal parasitical
problems caused by roundworms, pinworms, tapeworms, and liver flukes with Albendazole. But it is
ineffective against external parasites. It is administered orally in the form of tablets, pills, or
oral suspensions. However, it is to be noted that Albendazole is not used against agricultural and
household pests. Albendazole was developed in 1975. It is on the World Health Organization's List of
Essential Medicines for animals.

What animal diseases can abendazole be used for?

Albendazole is anthelmintic for veterinary use in cattle, sheep, goats, swine, camels, dogs, cats,
elephants, and poultry. It is a medication that is widely used for the treatment of a variety of
parasitic worm infestations. Although Albendazole is mainly used in cattle and sheep, it is found
effective in cats and dogs as well. It is also used in ratite birds and swine to flagellate
parasites and tapeworms.

Can albendazole be used to treat human diseases?

Albendazole is a medical drug administered as an effective treatment for infections caused by
flatworms, tapeworms, hookworms, etc. in humans. Albendazole is effective in treating many diseases.
It is FDA-approved for treating hydatid disease caused by dog tapeworm larvae and neurocysticercosis
caused by pork tapeworm larvae.

What are the benefits of albendazole for human health?

Albendazole is an anthelmintic or anti-worm medication. It is administered to prevent newly hatched
insect larvae (worms) from growing or multiplying in the human body. Albendazole is used to treat
certain infections caused by worms such as pork tapeworm. Albendazole is effective if taken after
eating sufficient food

Annual production of 100 tons of ivermectin, 10 tons of acetamiprid, 500 tons of albendazole, 50
tons of trimethoprim, 50 tons of trimethoprim phosphate, 50 tons of tetrahydropalmatine
hydrochloride, and other products

T/T in advance or L/C at sight

Generally, regular orders can be delivered within 2 weeks. Large scale orders need to be determined

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

⟶][127]

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

[⟶][114]
[

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]
[

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs. 

[⟶][118]
[

### Our CDMO Services

][119]

We offer fully integrated **CDMO services **covering the entire process: from initial planning and
supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

[⟶][120]

## Our Network

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

## Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd.: Leading the Way in Pharma Manufacturing

▼

Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. stands as India’s largest and most trusted Contract Development
and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Akums collaborates with 1500+ pharmaceutical companies, manufacturing over 4100+ commercialized
formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

While innovation fuels our growth, sustainability shapes our future. Akums integrates eco-friendly
initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

Leading the Make in India initiative, Akums continues to revolutionize global healthcare by
providing high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical solutions with a patient-first approach,
strengthening its position as a driving force in the industry.

Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. stands as India’s largest and most trusted Contract Development
and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Akums collaborates with 1500+ pharmaceutical companies, manufacturing over 4100+ commercialized
formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

While innovation fuels our growth, sustainability shapes our future. Akums integrates eco-friendly
initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

Leading the Make in India initiative, Akums continues to revolutionize global healthcare by
providing high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical solutions with a patient-first approach,
strengthening its position as a driving force in the industry.

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

# MOVING IN UNISON

We work as a flexible, attentive extension of your team; we offer the contract research organization
services you need to move your molecule from preclinical to Phase I, Phase II, and beyond.

[ Contact Us ][14]

transparency, compliance, and decision-making.

[Read now! ][17]

[A Day in the Life of A Molecule]

#### A Day in the Life of A Molecule

Press play to meet Mike the Molecule—he’s got big dreams and a big journey ahead! Follow along as he
takes on every stage of drug development here at Altasciences.Science has never been this fun!

[Learn more! ][18]

[A Day in the Life of a Veterinary Scientist, Ophthalmology]

#### A Day in the Life of a Veterinary Scientist, Ophthalmology

Marianna Bacellar-Galdino has always loved scientific research, and after a particularly eye-opening
project in veterinary school, ophthalmology became the thread connecting all her scientific
interests—and eventually her whole career.

[Watch now! ][19]

We are a forward-thinking, mid-size early phase contract research organization, in Canada and the
U.S., offering biopharmaceutical companies of all sizes a proven, flexible approach to early drug
development, including preclinical safety testing, clinical pharmacology (Phase I to Phase II),
bioanalysis (preclinical to Phase IV), research services, and manufacturing and analytical services.

Focused on your success … always available and always looking ahead ... moving in unison to deliver
big impact with a personal touch.

## WHAT WE DO

We help you reach early phase drug development decision-making milestones sooner, improving speed
and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.
* [ [Preclinical Services] ][20]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Preclinical Services ][21]
  
  Safety assessments for both small and large molecules
* [ [Clinical Services] ][22]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Clinical Services ][23]
  
  Clinical pharmacology trials from first-in-human to end of Phase II
* [ [Manufacturing and Analytical Services] ][24]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Manufacturing and Analytical Services ][25]
  
  From formulation development, Phase I through commercial manufacturing, and ICH stability testing
* [ [thumb] ][26]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Bioanalysis Services ][27]
  
  Package or stand-alone. Preclinical, Phase I to Phase IV bioanalytical laboratories
* [ [research support services] ][28]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Research Support Services ][29]
  
  Comprehensive CRO services to support clinical and preclinical studies

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

## Follow us and keep up to date

[about]

APMIDA Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. manufacturing Bulk Drug API derived from various chemicals which
have a growing demand globally. The company is linked with developed pieces of equipment of the
technology and machinery for the process of the manufacturing of the Medicine product. The state of
the art manufacturing is Drug licensed and GMP and ISO certifications. Along with this, our
production place has the following amenities:
* #### We have vast and spacious warehouse in excise free zones to do the other activities of the
  #### manufacturing of the drugs.
* #### Quality control Lab and Analytical Testing along with R&D Manufacturing facilities
* #### State Drug licenses
* #### FDA Registered

### We are Helping to Advance Health with Clinical Trials for Medicine.

APMIDA PHARMACEUTICALS Pvt. Ltd. is a vertically integrated company that develops, manufactures, and
sells Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API), High Potency API, and API intermediates. Our unique
research and synthesis facility reflects our commitment to research and innovation. The world-class
manufacturing facilities at APMIDA PHARMACEUTICALS Pvt. Ltd. are located in Dist. Rampur (UP)India.
These facilities are benchmarked to international standards and set to meet the rigorous quality
guideline, which is critical in achieving our global growth aspirations.

As a leading API supplier, our regulatory-approved facilities enable us to supply our partners all
over countries with a broad portfolio of products. Our expertise spans a variety of chemical
processes, Heterocyclic chemistry, Carbohydrates chemistry. Additionally, we manage enzyme
conversions for some of our products. Our manufacturing capacity for various categories ranges from
500MT/year to 800MT/Year.

### CARBOGEN AMCIS Commissions Ground-Mounted Pho-tovoltaic Plant at Its Hunzenschwil Site

CARBOGEN AMCIS, a Switzerland-based pharmaceutical process development and Active Pharmaceutical
Ingredient (API) manufacturing company, has suc-cessfully commissioned a new ground-mounted
photovoltaic system at its Hunzenschwil site in Switzerland. With this project, the company
underscores its long-term commitment to sustainability and the expansion of renewable energy.

identified following an on-site unannounced inspection.

# RELIABLE

* DISTRIBUTION
* INNOVATION
* PEOPLE

* WAREHOUSING

* SINCE 1885

Impeccable distribution of high-quality ingredients to the feed, food, pharma and technical
industries worldwide since 1885.

With roots dating back to 1885, Chr. Olesen has grown from a local Danish grocery store into an
international, family-owned business built on quality, reliability and long-term partnerships.

## FEED

The manufacturers constantly refine the ingredients. The producers constantly refine the products.
We pay respect to both by constantly refining the distribution.

Premium quality vitamins, minerals and proteins.
Developed by handpicked manufacturers.
And carefully distributed to the food industry.

### FOOD

### PHARMA

Distributing pharmaceutical ingredients requires specialized knowledge.  But it also requires
something as simple as being reliable.

Polymers, xantam gum and manganese carbonate. We distribute technical ingredients to the technical
industries.

### TECHNICAL INDUSTRIES

## A WORD IS A WORD.

### NO MATTER THE LANGUAGE.

Partnerships are crucial to us. And many of them have existed for generations.
* ### 140 years and we're just getting started
  
  2025 marked our 140^{th }anniversary. That’s worth celebrating. We’ve grown from a small grocery
  and goods store to a global firm with about 200 employees and 5^{th} generation family ownership.
  But the journey has only just started, as we will continue growing our family-run company – just
  as each generation has done before.
  [altText]

## RELIABLE

### SINCE 1885

We are not the same company today as we were when Mads Chr. Olesen founded his small grocery and
goods store back in 1885. But one thing is unchanged – being reliable in everything we do

[Explore our history][42]

### ALWAYS ON TIME.

#### Regardless of TIME ZONE.

Being on time. Every time. This is still as important to the 5^{th} generation as it was to the
founder.

## Reliable development
## Reliable distribution
## Reliable innovation
## Reliable through 5 generations

## CONTACT

how we can work together to grow your business.

## They're slow. They're expensive.

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a

veterinary networks—through transparent operations, ethical sourcing, and nationwide reliability.

* Creating long-term value by prioritizing patient safety and partner trust.

professionalism, and continuous innovation. Drugzone envisions a future where compliant and
affordable access to quality pharmaceuticals strengthens the entire continuum of care.

* Lead the U.S. market as a benchmark in generic pharmaceutical distribution.
* Advance technology-driven operations that enhance fulfillment speed and traceability.
* Build sustainable business practices that support healthcare accessibility nationwide.
* Foster a partner-first culture rooted in transparency and responsiveness.
* Continue setting new standards of reliability and trust across human and animal health sectors.

###### Welcome to Evologics

# Committed.

***Evologics***  is a surgical biologics distributor focused on human tissue allografts and related
products. We work with physicians, hospitals, and surgical centers to provide access to products for
surgical applications consistent with their official labeling and regulatory status.

***Evologics*** is proud to partner with industry leaders that have created and practice only the
highest bone and tissue sterilization processes. Using processes like PASCO2^{®}, our products are
sterilized while preserving biologic integrity, ensuring only high-quality bone, tissue and
allografts.

[ DOWNLOAD CATALOG ][68]

###### Our Values

## Safety, innovation and service.

###### 01.

##### Safety

Guided by our core values of accountability, precision, and transparency, we foster a culture where
safety is everyone’s priority. We are committed to protecting the health and well-being of patients,
partners, and communities by ensuring the highest standards of safety across every aspect of our
operations.

###### 02.

##### Innovation

We make lives better by combining our product innovations with compassion, ensuring healthcare
providers receive only the best products for their patients. By embracing cutting-edge technology
and creativity, we aim to improve patient outcomes, and create new standards in safety and standard
of care.

###### 03.

##### Service

We deliver exceptional service that consistently exceeds expectations, forging long-lasting, strong
relationships with our partners. We are dedicated to fostering trust, reliability, collaboration and
responsiveness with every interaction, empowering healthcare providers while improving patient
outcomes.

###### Our Products

## Committed to Quality

Evologics offers a wide array of products, including amnion, soft tissue allografts, bone and more
for a wide array of specialties, including spine, orthopedics, sports medicine, ophthalmology,
cosmetic surgery, podiatry and wound care.

##### EvoPatch Amnion

Minimally Manipulated Amniotic Tissue that can be used in open incision, laparoscopy and/or robotic
surgery procedures

##### Demineralized Bone Matrix

Available in multiple sizes to address a a wide array of procedures, including foot and ankle,
trauma and extremities, knees, hips, craniomaxillofacial, spine and more.

##### DBM Fiber

Demineralized cortical bone fibers that are entangled and shaped into sizes engineered to complement
specific surgical applications.

##### Bone and Tendon Allografts

Hard and soft allografts in a variety of configurations for most surgical applications.

###### Our Purpose

*“At Evologics, we understand successful business depends on a successful team. With the perfect
team, we continue to strive for excellence, providing healthcare professionals with products that
make people live better, healthier lives. We care more – and that’s what makes the difference.”*

Michael Crescenzo

][69]

Evologics is a biologics company committed to improving lives. Our culture places people, first –
from patients to doctors to our team.

Our mission is to make lives better through biologics products with the goal to help people to live
longer, healthier lives.

###### Welcome to Evologics

# Committed.

***Evologics***  is a surgical biologics distributor focused on human tissue allografts and related
products. We work with physicians, hospitals, and surgical centers to provide access to products for
surgical applications consistent with their official labeling and regulatory status.

***Evologics*** is proud to partner with industry leaders that have created and practice only the
highest bone and tissue sterilization processes. Using processes like PASCO2^{®}, our products are
sterilized while preserving biologic integrity, ensuring only high-quality bone, tissue and
allografts.

[ DOWNLOAD CATALOG ][68]

###### Our Values

## Safety, innovation and service.

###### 01.

##### Safety

Guided by our core values of accountability, precision, and transparency, we foster a culture where
safety is everyone’s priority. We are committed to protecting the health and well-being of patients,
partners, and communities by ensuring the highest standards of safety across every aspect of our
operations.

###### 02.

##### Innovation

We make lives better by combining our product innovations with compassion, ensuring healthcare
providers receive only the best products for their patients. By embracing cutting-edge technology
and creativity, we aim to improve patient outcomes, and create new standards in safety and standard
of care.

###### 03.

##### Service

We deliver exceptional service that consistently exceeds expectations, forging long-lasting, strong
relationships with our partners. We are dedicated to fostering trust, reliability, collaboration and
responsiveness with every interaction, empowering healthcare providers while improving patient
outcomes.

###### Our Products

## Committed to Quality

Evologics offers a wide array of products, including amnion, soft tissue allografts, bone and more
for a wide array of specialties, including spine, orthopedics, sports medicine, ophthalmology,
cosmetic surgery, podiatry and wound care.

##### EvoPatch Amnion

Minimally Manipulated Amniotic Tissue that can be used in open incision, laparoscopy and/or robotic
surgery procedures

##### Demineralized Bone Matrix

Available in multiple sizes to address a a wide array of procedures, including foot and ankle,
trauma and extremities, knees, hips, craniomaxillofacial, spine and more.

##### DBM Fiber

Demineralized cortical bone fibers that are entangled and shaped into sizes engineered to complement
specific surgical applications.

##### Bone and Tendon Allografts

Hard and soft allografts in a variety of configurations for most surgical applications.

###### Our Purpose

*“At Evologics, we understand successful business depends on a successful team. With the perfect
team, we continue to strive for excellence, providing healthcare professionals with products that
make people live better, healthier lives. We care more – and that’s what makes the difference.”*

Michael Crescenzo

[
[default-logo]
][69]

Evologics is a biologics company committed to improving lives. Our culture places people, first –
from patients to doctors to our team.

Our mission is to make lives better through biologics products with the goal to help people to live
longer, healthier lives.

Copyright © 2026 E

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

Today, We Are
* [icon]
  
  ### 52,000 MTPA Capacity – 96+ Billion Tablets/Year

  ### Having presence in 65+ countries
* [icon]
  
  ### Backwardly integrated for PAP
* [icon]
  
  ### Forward integration for DC
* [icon]
  
  ### Only Paracetamol Manufacturer with RC Logo (2023)
* [icon]
  
  ### 23% Global Market Share in API Paracetamol
* [icon]
  
  ### 40% Domestic India Market Share in Paracetamol API

## Our Pharmaceutical API Products & Formulations

### Paracetamol API – Multiple Grades for Every Formulation

Paracetamol, being the safest & the most affordable Analgesic & Antipyretic drug, is used for
treating fever, flu, body pain and cold.

### Paracetamol DC Granules – Directly Compressible for Tablet Production

Our DC provides drum-to-feeder compression/encapsulation solutions that are both economically sound
and operationally simple.

### New APIs – Theophylline, Rivaroxaban, Folic Acid & More

Introducing Our Latest API Range from Units 4 & 5

### Caffeine Anhydrous API

EU GMP Certified, 600 MT/Month

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

Welcome to Flagship

FLAGSHIP BIOTECH INTERNATIONAL PVT. LTD. is fully integrated Pharmaceutical company with an
established presence across the globe in more than 45 countries.

The company is headquartered in India - Mumbai.

We are the fastest growing Indian pharmaceutical company engaged into Manufacturing and Marketing a
broad range of pharmaceutical preparations globally.

We believe that our competitive advantage in the International Market lies in our established
presence in all major therapeutic areas including Oncology, Anti-Diabetic, Cardiology, Pain and
Analgesics, Gynecology, Anti-infectives, Vitamins, Minerals, Nutrients, Gastro-Intestinal,
Anti-Osteoporosis, Anti-Malarial, Immunosuppressant, Anti-Bacterial, Anti- Asthmatics, Anti-Allergy
etc.

We provide affordable and quality medicines across the world, regardless of Geographic and Socio
Economic barriers.

Flagship Biotech International has set benchmarks for Pharmaceutical Manufacturing and achieved a
Marketing Excellence in the Branded Generics- Ethical, API, Formulations, OTC & Institutional
segments globally and has emerged as a respectable name in the Global Pharmaceutical and Healthcare
Arena.

[api]

Manufacturing

Flagship Biotech International provides the advanced manufacturing capabilities and processes that
create special quality of Generic Products.

The reputation of our company is built on Manufacturing and R&D facilities that are designed to meet
Global Standards, and Stringent Quality standards that ensure we deliver only the best formulations
and products.

Our state of the Art Manufacturing Facilities maintaining high Quality Standards at every further
stage and Manufacturing process are located in Tarapur near Mumbai (Maharashtra, India) Navsari,
Naroda (Gujrat, India), Baddi (Himachal Pradesh, India)

Manufacturing facilities with the quality standards of global regulatory authorities including the
WHO – GMP, US FDA, MCC, PICS HEALTH CANADA and various other approvals.

It has capability to manufacture high quality Solid & Liquid Dosage Form, LVP, SVP, Speciality
Injectables, Powder for Injections, Inhalers, Ointments and Creams etc.

We have cost leadership with large scale, complex products.

The company endeavors to Manufacturing rich array of Quality Formulation supported by its strong
Formulation & Development department and State-of-Art Manufacturing facilities for its own market
and for several reputed organizations in India and Abroad. The company is committed to implement
Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Laboratory Practices (GLP) in its pursuit of continues
business growth.

[global network]

Our Presence

It has a strong global network in more than 45 countries.

#### International Marketing

Flagship has extensive presence in many countries in Asia, Africa and Latin America, CIS, EUROPE,
Australia & Pacific Ocean with Vast product portfolio to suit the needs of each country.

**Asia:**
* Middle East - Iraq, Syria, Jordan, Iran, Egypt, Lebanon
* South East – Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Vietnam, Myanmar, Srilanka, Maldives, Hong Kong,
  Taiwan, Afghanistan

**Africa:** Egypt, Seychelles, Kenya, Uganda, Zambia, South Africa, Nigeria, Morocco, Mauritius,
Madagascar, Mali, Zimbabwe, Ghana, Mozambique, Angola, Sierra Leone, Liberia, Burkina Faso, Senegal,
Benin, Ethiopia etc.

**Latin AMERICA:** Mexico, Guatemala, Cuba, Haiti, Dominican Republic, Honduras, El Salvador,
Nicaragua, Costa Rica, Panama, Uruguay, Jamaica Barbados, Peru, Chile, Paraguay, Suriname,
Venezuela, Guyana, Trinidad &Tobago, Ecuador, Bolivia.

**CIS:** Russia, Kazakhstan, Belarus, Ukraine

**Australia & Pacific Ocean:** New Zealand, Papua new Guiana, Fiji.

Welcome to Flagship

FLAGSHIP BIOTECH INTERNATIONAL PVT. LTD. is fully integrated Pharmaceutical company with an
established presence across the globe in more than 45 countries.

The company is headquartered in India - Mumbai.

We are the fastest growing Indian pharmaceutical company engaged into Manufacturing and Marketing a
broad range of pharmaceutical preparations globally.

We believe that our competitive advantage in the International Market lies in our established
presence in all major therapeutic areas including Oncology, Anti-Diabetic, Cardiology, Pain and
Analgesics, Gynecology, Anti-infectives, Vitamins, Minerals, Nutrients, Gastro-Intestinal,
Anti-Osteoporosis, Anti-Malarial, Immunosuppressant, Anti-Bacterial, Anti- Asthmatics, Anti-Allergy
etc.

We provide affordable and quality medicines across the world, regardless of Geographic and Socio
Economic barriers.

Flagship Biotech International has set benchmarks for Pharmaceutical Manufacturing and achieved a
Marketing Excellence in the Branded Generics- Ethical, API, Formulations, OTC & Institutional
segments globally and has emerged as a respectable name in the Global Pharmaceutical and Healthcare
Arena.

[api]

Manufacturing

Flagship Biotech International provides the advanced manufacturing capabilities and processes that
create special quality of Generic Products.

The reputation of our company is built on Manufacturing and R&D facilities that are designed to meet
Global Standards, and Stringent Quality standards that ensure we deliver only the best formulations
and products.

Our state of the Art Manufacturing Facilities maintaining high Quality Standards at every further
stage and Manufacturing process are located in Tarapur near Mumbai (Maharashtra, India) Navsari,
Naroda (Gujrat, India), Baddi (Himachal Pradesh, India)

Manufacturing facilities with the quality standards of global regulatory authorities including the
WHO – GMP, US FDA, MCC, PICS HEALTH CANADA and various other approvals.

It has capability to manufacture high quality Solid & Liquid Dosage Form, LVP, SVP, Speciality
Injectables, Powder for Injections, Inhalers, Ointments and Creams etc.

We have cost leadership with large scale, complex products.

The company endeavors to Manufacturing rich array of Quality Formulation supported by its strong
Formulation & Development department and State-of-Art Manufacturing facilities for its own market
and for several reputed organizations in India and Abroad. The company is committed to implement
Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Laboratory Practices (GLP) in its pursuit of continues
business growth.

[global network]

Our Presence

It has a strong global network in more than 45 countries.

#### International Marketing

Flagship has extensive presence in many countries in Asia, Africa and Latin America, CIS, EUROPE,
Australia & Pacific Ocean with Vast product portfolio to suit the needs of each country.

**Asia:**
* Middle East - Iraq, Syria, Jordan, Iran, Egypt, Lebanon
* South East – Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Vietnam, Myanmar, Srilanka, Maldives, Hong Kong,
  Taiwan, Afghanistan

**Africa:** Egypt, Seychelles, Kenya, Uganda, Zambia, South Africa, Nigeria, Morocco, Mauritius,
Madagascar, Mali, Zimbabwe, Ghana, Mozambique, Angola, Sierra Leone, Liberia, Burkina Faso, Senegal,
Benin, Ethiopia etc.

**Latin AMERICA:** Mexico, Guatemala, Cuba, Haiti, Dominican Republic, Honduras, El Salvador,
Nicaragua, Costa Rica, Panama, Uruguay, Jamaica Barbados, Peru, Chile, Paraguay, Suriname,
Venezuela, Guyana, Trinidad &Tobago, Ecuador, Bolivia.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries.

## GMP+ Feed Certification scheme

The GMP+ Feed Certification (GMP+ FC) scheme provides internationally recognised standards to
produce safe feed, and a growing set of international standards for sustainable feed.

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

[ Collaborations ][61]

[Our chain approach]

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

### Independent audits


GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

[ Benefits ][62]

## Subscribe to our newsletters


At GMP+ International we believe that sharing knowledge is a prerequisite for a safe and sustainable
feed chain. Please sign up for our newsletters with information about our scheme, training
opportunities, sector developments, feed legislation and more. In this way you are always informed.

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

[ Collaborations ][61]

[Our chain approach]

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

### Independent audits


GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

[ Benefits ][62]

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

**About the National Association of Boards of Pharmacy **


The National Association of Boards of Pharmacy (NABP) is the impartial professional organization
that supports its member regulatory state boards of pharmacy in creating uniform regulations to
protect public health. Founded in 1904, NABP aims to ensure the public’s health and safety through
its pharmacist competence assessment programs, license transfer and verification services, as well
as through pharmacy inspection and accreditation programs. For more information, please visit
[*www.nabp.pharmacy*][57].

“NABP congratulates Hauser Pharmaceutical on this reaccreditation, and their ongoing dedication  to
preventing counterfeit drugs from entering the US drug supply,” says NABP Executive
Director/Secretary Carmen A. Catizone, MS, RPh, DPh. “This reaccreditation
signifies Hauser Pharmaceutical's pivotal role in protecting the public health from counterfeit
drugs.”

as through pharmacy inspection and accreditation programs. For more information, please visit
[*www.nabp.pharmacy*][57].

## Global Market Transformation

In a recent feature published by ODT Magazine, Husnu Ceylan shared his perspective on the
transformation of the global orthobiologics market and the increasingly strategic role these
solutions play in modern orthopedic care. During the interview, Ceylan highlighted that market
growth is being driven by a convergence of demographic, clinical, and structural factors, but most
importantly by a shift in surgical thinking. Today, surgeons are not only focused on mechanical
stabilization, but are increasingly seeking biological solutions that enhance healing, improve
functional outcomes, and deliver greater long-term clinical predictability. As Ceylan noted, the
growth of orthobiologics is not simply about increasing procedure volumes, but about the evolution
of surgical care itself, where biology is becoming an essential component of standard orthopedic and
spine treatment. The feature also underscores how orthobiologics have evolved beyond a niche segment
to become increasingly integrated across spine, trauma, sports medicine, and complex reconstruction
procedures, reinforcing their role as one of the fastest-evolving areas in musculoskeletal care.
Read the full article here: Au Naturel: How Orthobiologics Are Reshaping Care
